article_summaries.title: Community Event: House Party Tuesday!
article_summaries.summary: SOE announced a new weekly House Party community event in which players meet in Sanctuary and visit decorated player homes, with the Community Team's 'House Party' character teleporting between houses. The post gives the first event as Tuesday March 23, 2010 at 4pm Pacific on Server 1, and notes the Game Guide teleport would not work that week so players had to arrive on foot.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A freerealms.com community event notice announcing a recurring 'House Party Tuesday' in which players meet in Sanctuary and visit decorated player homes, with a special 'House Party' character teleporting to featured houses. The first listed session was Tuesday April 6, 2010 at 3pm Pacific Time on Server 1. The post date is not stated exactly (only a relative 'posted 2 weeks, 2 days ago').

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A Community Team event report (posted roughly four days before the capture) covering a Trade Faire in Seaside, the weekly House Party Tuesday in Sanctuary, and a party for the opening of the Pirate's Plunder minigame on the Seaside docks. It also explains how to find community events through the Game Guide calendar and the GO button.

article_summaries.title: Community Event: House Party Tuesday!
article_summaries.summary: A Free Realms community event page announcing a recurring 'House Party' tour held every Tuesday in Sanctuary, where a Community Team character visits featured player-decorated homes. It gives the event date and times for the April 12, 2010 instance and explains how players can find events through the Game Guide calendar.

article_summaries.title: Community Event: House Party Tuesday!
article_summaries.summary: Official freerealms.com news post announcing a recurring weekly community event, House Party Tuesday, held in Sanctuary on Server 1, where players gather and visit decorated player homes. A Community Team character named "House Party" teleports to featured houses, and players can reach the event through the Game Guide calendar.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A Free Realms community event announcement for the weekly 'House Party Tuesday' gathering held in Sanctuary, where players visit decorated player homes. The featured theme for the week of June 15, 2010 was Camping, with houses using tents, campfires and decorations from Chatty and Robbie's Summer Camps. It also explains how to find community events via the Game Guide calendar and its GO button.
